title: CardCorpus distributions
description: Every distribution. A distribution is one way cards reached people other than in booster packs: a boxed product with a promo inside ("151 Collection—Alakazam ex"), an event ("Regional Championships"), a shop or restaurant giveaway ("McDonald's Happy Meal 2019", "Burger King"), a program ("Play! Pokémon Prize Pack"), a campaign, a magazine or book, a test run, or cards given to staff. A variant says which distributions it came out through in its own `distributions`; a set says it once where every card of it came out one way. Each entry here counts those variants and sets, and distributions/{id}.json lists them. `series` then groups the distributions that recur: "McDonald's Happy Meal" holds each year's Happy Meal, "World Championships" each year's event (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#distributions).

distributionCount.description: How many distributions; always present, 0 included.

category.description: What kind of distribution it is: a product, an event, a program, a shop, a campaign, a publication, a test run or staff.

series.description: The series it belongs to, where it recurs: "McDonald's Happy Meal" for "McDonald's Happy Meal 2011".

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `distribution-series`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

name.description: A copy of the target's own `name`.

variantCount.description: How many variants that came out through it: every variant of the sets that name it, and the variants that name it themselves; always present, 0 included.

setCount.description: How many sets whose every card came out through it (Burger King has two); 0 where only single variants name it; always present, 0 included.

catalogs.description: The catalogs its variants are in.

series.description: Every distribution series: distributions that recur under one name, such as a yearly event or promotion ("World Championships", "Collector's Tins").

name.description: Its name, without the year or season: "McDonald's Happy Meal".

category.description: What kind of distribution it is: a product, an event, a program, a shop, a campaign, a publication, a test run or staff.

distributions.description: Its distributions, in order (by the year and season each name gives).

$kind.description: What the pointer points at: `distribution`. index.json's `pointers` say where to find it (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#pointers).

variantCount.description: How many variants that came out through its distributions; always present, 0 included.

catalogs.description: The catalogs its variants are in.
